This systemic bias has led to a significant power imbalance that curtails the Reformist faction's political influence and hinders their ability to effect meaningful change. Despite these obstacles, the alliance remains a powerful voice for reform and continues to shape political debate.

Intriguingly, the clamor for reform has echoed within the ranks of the United Sordland Party (USP) itself, where a faction advocating for liberal policies has emerged. This internal faction, although ostensibly part of the establishment, shares some common ground with the Reformist Alliance, adding another layer of complexity to Sordland's political scene. The persistence of the Reformist Alliance, coupled with the emergence of reform-minded elements within the USP, illustrates the evolving dynamics of Sordland's political landscape.

The Gendarmerie of the Republic of Sordland is an armed law enforcement organization which maintains security, safety and public order in the rural regions of Sordland and executes the duties ascribed to it by other laws. The Gendarmerie General Command is subordinated to the Ministry of Defense.

The Gendarmerie Organization, which was established in 1899, has survived until today. After the Republic was proclaimed, the gendarmerie stations began to serve people in the most remote parts of the country in addition to carrying out security and public order duties. During Soll’s term as president, most people began to identify Gendarmerie with the state itself.

The Grand National Assembly of Sordland, usually referred to simply as the Assembly, is the unicameral Sordish legislature. It is the sole body given the legislative prerogatives by the Sordish Constitution. It was founded in Holsord on September 9th, 1923 in the midst of the September Revolution. The parliament was fundamental in the efforts of President Artur S. Wisci and his colleagues to found a new state out of the remnants of the Kingdom of Sordland.

It is currently led by the Speaker of the Assembly Gloria Tory, who also represents the conservatives within the United Sordland Party.

The National Business Council is the official government structure that includes most of the leading business leaders of Sordland. They are participating in a cooperation with the government on improving the economic prospects. Many details including state projects, incentives, taxes, unemployment and the future of the country are discussed here.

It is led by Mikail Aven, representing the private sector, and Symon Holl representing the state sector. This council gathers when deemed necessary by the majority of its members of the two leaders.

Sordish Armed Forces (SAF) are the military forces of the Republic of Sordland. With its headquarters in Holsord, SAF consist of the General Staff, the Land Forces, the Naval forces and the Air Forces. The current chief of the General Staff and the chief of the Armed Forces is General Valken Kruger.

In wartime, the Chief of the General Staff may act as the Commander-in-Chief on behalf of the President. The General Staff also holds the authority to reject a president’s candidate for the position of Minister of Defense, and may appoint its own candidate when they deem it necessary.

The Sordish military perceives itself as the guardian of Sollism, the official ideology of the second republic era of the Republic of Sordland.

The Sordish Armed Forces is the fifth largest standing military force in Eastern Merkopa after the Rumburgian Armed Forces. Currently, the military is a conscripted force; males serve in the military upon reaching the age of 18.

The Sordish Police Force is headed by Karl Greiser. The force has extensive rights and some argue more than most countries surrounding Sordland with the exception of Rumburg. These rights were given through the Security Package Laws of Tarquin Soll.

The police are tasked with enforcing the law in the country. They establish security, civil order and peace. As one of the very old institutions in the country, dating back to the Renan Aristocracy, a large section of society still heavily respects the force.

Internally, it is structured at regional levels which are tied to the ministry of interior led by Lileas Graf.

The Supreme Court of Sordland is the highest legal body for constitutional and judicial review. It examines the constitutionality, in respect of both form and substance, of laws, decrees having the force of law, and the Rules of Procedure of the Grand National Assembly. If necessary, it also functions as the Supreme Criminal Court to hear any cases raised about the President of Sordland, members of the Cabinet, or presidents and members of the high courts. The Justices of the Supreme Court may ‘hold their office during behaviour.’

The Supreme Court has the right to review enactments both before and after review, and it can invalidate whole laws or governmental decrees and prevent their application in future cases. The Supreme Court also functions as the second legislative body, when a proposal to change the Constitution of Sordland passes the Grand National Assembly of Sordland, giving them the final vote on constitutional changes. It is currently led by the Chief Justice Orso Hawker who was elected with a majority of seven to four in 1937.

The Arcasian Treaty Organisation (ATO) is an intergovernmental military and economic alliance between 14 countries. Primarily led by Arcasia, the alliance aims to bring all it's members together in united economic and defense framework against CSP.

With ATO's strategic military alliance heavily consists of countries with capitalist economic structures. Its aim is to counter the influence of United Contana around the globe and protect Merkopa from the expansion of socialism.

Recently, the ATO has become increasingly focused on increasing the nuclear protection as the new military weapon has advanced enough to become part of warfare.

The Contanan Security Pact (CSP) is an intergovernmental military and economic alliance established in late 1946 by Chairman Leon Malenyev of United Contana. Formed in direct response to the creation of the Arcasian Treaty Organization (ATO), the CSP serves as a unified defense and economic bloc against the growing influence of Arcasian capitalism.

Led by United Contana, the alliance primarily consists of states with planned economies that engage in resource-sharing and centralized trade. Its core objective is to protect the sovereignty of socialist nations and prevent the expansion of liberal capitalist influence across Contana and beyond.

In recent years, the CSP has sought to extend its geopolitical reach into Merkopa by strengthening cooperation with aligned nations such as Valgsland. Through military coordination, ideological solidarity, and regional partnerships, the pact remains the principal counterweight to ATO-led initiatives in the ongoing global rivalry.

The Alphonso Foundation is a non-profit organization founded in 1953 by Ewald Alphonso, the third President of Sordland. After stepping away from politics, Alphonso redirected his focus towards charitable pursuits, channeling his resources to establish this organization.

The foundation primarily focuses on addressing homelessness and mitigating income inequality. It adopts a comprehensive approach in combating homelessness by not only providing immediate aid but also working towards long-term solutions such as affordable housing and employment programs. The foundation's initiatives related to income inequality involve efforts to promote fair wages, improve access to education, and support policies that favor economic balance.

FC Anrica is a Sordish professional football club based in Anrica, that plays in the Sordish Superliga, the top tier in Sordish football. Founded as Markiansport in 1905, the club changed to various names before settling on being called after its home city in 1923 as FC Anrica. Since 1940, FC Anrica’s home ground has been the Maroon Stadium, nicknamed ‘The Hall of Martyrs’, one of the largest stadiums in Sordland and in all Eastern Merkopa.

FC Anrica is known as a people's club with a huge national support, particularly from the Greater Holsord region. The club has a longstanding rivalry with FC Gelsord. Its anthem is ‘Eye-to-Eye, Tooth-to-Tooth’.

FC Anrica has been playing in the Sordish Superliga since the league’s inception in 1944. They are the one of the only two teams who had managed to claim the league title apart from FC Gelsord.

FC Gelsord is a Sordish professional football club based in Gelsord, that plays in the Sordish Superliga, the top tier in Sordish football. Founded in 1904, FC Gelsord has been the most successful club in Sordland. FC Gelsord plays at the Artor Wisci Arena, which opened as the Soll Arena in 1935 and was renamed in 1949.

FC Gelsord has a huge national support, particularly from the Gelsland and Nargis regions. The club has a longstanding rivalry with FC Anrica. Its anthem is ‘FC Gelsord is the only way forward’ which is derived from the city of Gelsord’s official motto ‘Science is the only way forward.’

FC Gelsord has been playing in the Sordish Superliga since the league’s inception in 1944, winning almost all Superliga titles since.

Holsord State University is a public research university located in Holsord, Sordland. It is the second oldest institute after the Markian Imperial University. The current rector is Sander Navek.

The HSU has educated many notable alumni, including the Speaker of the Assembly Gloria Tory, the famous political scientist Herman Equa, Justice of the Supreme Court Isabel Edmonds. As of 1954, 7 Renan laureates, 6 Avns Medal winners, and 1 Merkopa Science Award winner have been affiliated with the university. Alumni of the HSU have established strong, respectable positions in the legal, technological, and literary hubs of the world.

The HSU is generally accepted as one of the leading higher educational institutions in Eastern Merkopa.

The Lotherberg Group is a private non-government organization which assesses the economic conditions of Sordland and the globe. Currently, the spokesman of the organization is Walter Tusk, who was elected by a majority vote. Officially, Lotherberg has a vague structure and limited leadership roles, but the spokesman is considered to be the de-facto leader of the entity. The Group convenes every three months at Hotel Berg in the village of Lotherg.

The meetings are held in secret, but reports suggest that they cover topics such as the economy, security, and international politics in detail. While most of its members remain unknown, the group consists of the wealthiest figures in Sordish society. The only public-facing member is Walter Tusk, who serves as its official spokesperson.

Due to the influential nature of the organization and the privacy of their affairs in the eyes of the public, theories have sprung up that the future of Eastern Merkopa is decided at these conferences.

The Sordish League of Women is a prominent non-governmental organization (NGO) primarily focused on advocating for women's rights in Sordland. It is recognized for its influential role in fostering gender equality, raising social awareness, and propelling progressive change in the nation.

The organization is well known for its significant initiatives, such as organizing large-scale fundraising campaigns and peaceful protest marches. These actions are designed to mobilize public opinion and generate resources for the cause of gender equality. Notably, the Sordish League of Women has called attention to pressing issues such as domestic violence, the gender wage gap, the lack of maternity leave, and systemic sexism in the educational sphere.

Demonstrations organized by the League have, at times, been met with opposition from conservative and religious groups, reflecting the societal divisions that persist in Sordland. Nevertheless, the organization persists in its advocacy, tirelessly working to safeguard and advance women's rights. The Sordish League of Women has also been linked to the efforts of First Lady Monica Rayne, who shares a similar agenda for women's rights in Sordland.

The Radical is one of the most critical and anti-establishment newspapers in Sordland. Many of the previous journalists from the newspaper have been arrested in the Soll period. People who are critical of the government and the recent events tend to flock to this newspaper.

Founded after the toppling of the first President of the Republic of Sordland it's motto always has been critical thinking. Their unchecked voice was mostly not welcomed by government officials who often tried to silence the newspaper, but still has not managed to do so. The Radical wants radical change in Sordland and they are not afraid to voice their opinions.

The LUS is the oldest NGO of Sordland. Its current spokesperson is Katarina Horten. The Labour Union aims to create better working conditions for all by organizing the workers inside companies and calling them to organize big strikes to disrupt services or production.

Many seem to regard the Labor Union as a foreign influenced NGO but there hardly seems to exist any proof on the matter. In the past decades it has been unexpectedly successful in increasing the wages of workers in several industries, but their greatest achievement was in the year of 1914 when they led a large miners strike in Estord and challenged the king.

Needless to say, the royal guards tried to oppress the workers, who they saw as revolutionaries. The royalists failed, and the king gave in on the advice of the economic advisor of the time, Heron Walt. Ever since that time, the LUS has been snatching minor victories against big companies.

The Communist Party of Sordland (CPS) is a communist political party in Sordland. It was founded in 1950 with hopes to bring together the many separate left-wing organizations in Sordland under one flag. The party has positioned itself between Malenyevism and Valgslandian socialism.

The party was established by a group of Malenyevist politicians, union leaders and a number of activists who were previously persecuted during Tarquin Soll’s term as president. It is considered as a continuation of the political party with the same name that existed in the early years of the Sordish republic, which was destroyed during the military coups and conflicts of the 20’s.

In the 1953 elections, the party won 8% of the vote, barely missing out on crossing the 10% election threshold in Sordland.

The National Front Party (NFP) is a nationalist ultraconservative political party in Sordland, which currently is the second biggest opposition party in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland. It is led by Kesaro Kibener. 

The NFP was established in 1931 by a group of young nationalists, including Kesaro Kibener, in the city of Jen. The party mainly followed an ethnic nationalist political agenda with aggressive and threatening campaigns throughout the 30’s, which made it to be perceived as an extremist party, but later moderated its views under the leadership of Kesaro Kibener, who took over the leadership in 1949 and worked towards making the party more approachable for a larger audience. 

In the 53’ elections NFP gained the best results in its history, becoming the third biggest party in Sordland.
The People’s Freedom and Justice Party

The People’s Freedom and Justice Party (PFJP) is a political party in Sordland which has promoted both liberalism and social democracy in the country. It is currently the main opposition in the Grand National Assembly of Sordland.

The PFJP was established during the Lachaven Congress in 1932 as a union of opposition groups against the government of Tarquin Soll. Traditionally anchored in the center-left of the political spectrum, the party has historically connected with various segments of society, from middle to upper-middle classes, encompassing professionals, government employees, academia, students, progressive thinkers, and union members. 

Internal tensions emerged as the party leadership increasingly diverged from its left-wing supporters, with Bludish voters feeling particularly alienated. This ideological drift was further accelerated by Ricter's embrace of market-oriented economic policies.

They represent the reformist faction of the Grand National Assembly, advocating for a more democratic constitution. The party opposes the constitution written by Tarquin Soll and deems it undemocratic. They are seen as the alternate to the USP and have been a major force in Sordish politics since its first election. 

The PFJP has been steadily increasing its popularity among the Sordish population who are unhappy with their current situation.

The United Sordland Party (USP) is a political party in Sordland. It is the oldest political party in the country, and is currently acting as the governing party. As the self-proclaimed unifying force behind Sordland's establishment, the United Sordland Party presents itself as a contemporary democratic organization that adheres to the republic's foundational tenets. Its logo consists of the three arrows shining from a lightbulb, which represent the foundational principles of Sollism: republicanism, nationalism, and statism.

It was founded by Tarquin Soll in 1929, following the end of the Sordish Civil War. It participated in the first elections after the war with no contest and was elected into government. It has been the leading party in Sordish politics since 1929 without any disruptions. In the 1940’s, the party slowly started to protest against Tarquin Soll’s authoritarian policies and strayed from the Sollist ideology.

With the new reformist faction increasing their influence in the 1940’s, Ewald Alphonso called for a congress and managed to win against Tarquin Soll, which made Soll resign from his position as chairman of the USP in 1946. Ewald Alphonso served as the second chairman of the USP and was elected President in 1949. His term saw many changes to the USP with many of the old leadership leaving or being evicted from the party. Alphonso administration pushed for free market reforms which resulted in the Recession of ‘51. This helped Anton Rayne rise up as a young new leader during the tumultuous period of the party with its lost identity.

Worker's Party of Bludia (WPB) is a Bludish political party in Sordland, which garners most of its support from the Bergia region. Generally left-wing, the party places a strong emphasis on participatory democracy, unions, minority rights and egalitarianism. The party brought great criticism for the usage of the Bludish name (Bludia) for the region of Bergia in its name.

Aspiring to fundamentally challenge the existing Sordish-Bludish divide and other existing parameters in Sordish politics, the WPB was founded in 1948 as the continuation of the Bludish movement started by the Bludish Freedom Party. Despite their name, they claim to be a political party representing the whole region of Bergia and want to represent all of Sordland regardless of ethnic backgrounds, rejecting the label of Bludish nationalism.

Some members of the USP has claimed that the WPB has direct ties with Bludish Freedom Front (BFF) which was not proven and have been numerously denied by its members. In the 1949, the party put forward its earlier chairman, Mansoun Leke, who won 6% of the vote. Leke had then resigned from the party and ran as an independent to bypass the 10% election threshold. In 1953 elections, the party won 9% of the vote, barely losing the elections this time, despite concerns that the departure of Leke may result in lower votes.

The Red Youth is a political organization with alleged connections to a number of insurgent attacks against the Sordish government. It was founded in 1923 by a group of revolutionaries, who were inspired by the communist revolution in United Contana and came together to promote Malenyevist ideas during the early days of the republic.

After the military coup in ‘27, they continued for some time as an underground organization. Their members participated in the Sordish Civil War and continued their protests after the war. Throughout the 20’s, they engaged in urban warfare with right-wing militants. Despite heavy crackdown of their forces during Tarquin Soll’s term as president, they managed to gather major support in many universities around Sordland.

Red Youth members participated in the protests against the Arcasian 2nd Fleet anchoring in Sordland in the 1940's, and also played an active role in the workers' actions in the early 1950’s.

Young Sords is a right-wing nationalist political organization, with alleged connections to a number of armed attacks against the Sordish government. They are a youth organization that has close ties to the National Front Party. Often it has been associated with the Black Battalion and been linked to the parties more violent wing. The organization often hides behind these claims by highlighting it's cultural works.

The Young Sords was formed by General Luderin in 1927 rising in popularity and participating as a combatant in the Sordish Civil War. It often clashed with other left-wing groups, primarily with Rikardists and for a brief period engaged with Sollist forces. Initially journalists, but later historians identified the entity to have activities corresponding to that of a death squad.

A staunchly pan-Sordist organization, in the early 1930’s, the Young Sords have managed to extend their area of operation into Sordish speaking post-revolution Valgsland. Most people suspect the Young Sords to be part of the Sordish 'Old Guards', and there seems some inconclusive reports that both the Holsord Police and the Supreme Court had dealings with them.
